description: This file contains test helpers and fixture data functions for the 'repositories_test' package, including functions to generate fake analysis and commit data, and utilities to clear database tables in tests.

methods.name: fakeFixtures
methods.description: Returns a sample slice of AnalyzedDiffRow with predefined fake data.

methods.name: fakeCommitFixtures
methods.description: Returns a sample slice of AnalyzedCommitRow with predefined fake commit data.

methods.name: clearTableBeforeAfterTest
methods.description: Returns a function that clears the specified database table, designed to be used in test setup and teardown.

methods.name: clearTable
methods.description: Executes a TRUNCATE TABLE statement for the given table name to clear its contents.
